fields.label: Phone / WhatsApp
fields.name: site_phone
fields.instructions: Customer service number for tel: links and the site-wide WhatsApp chat button. Use Indonesian format, e.g. 0812-3456-7890 or +62 812-3456-7890.

fields.label: Contact Form Email
fields.name: site_email
fields.instructions: Inbox for contact form submissions via wp_mail(). Leave empty to use ptfiazcakrawala@gmail.com.

fields.label: Google Maps
fields.name: site_maps_embed
fields.instructions: Paste embed iframe HTML from Google Maps (Share → Embed a map), embed URL (google.com/maps/embed?pb=...), share link, or leave empty to use Address field.
